text: If DAO members do not formalize a legal structure for their entity, courts are very likely to impose one on them, which is a serious risk of DAO membership.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) of DAOs (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3799320

isBasedOn.name: A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) of DAOs

abstract: However, a very serious risk is associated with DAO membership in the sense that if the DAO members do not formalize a structure for their human-created entity, courts are very likely to impose one for the members of the DAO.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: DAOs with no off-chain legal entity
